zh-CN.template.title: 交互光流
zh-CN.template.description: 基础 Web 型交互壁纸模板。鼠标移动与点击会生成动态光流，播放端通用滤镜、缩放、视差等逻辑由 PlayerWeb 适配。
zh-CN.template.hint: 移动鼠标或点击画面生成光流

en-US.template.title: Interactive Glow
en-US.template.description: Basic interactive web wallpaper template. Move or click the mouse to create glowing streams. PlayerWeb handles shared filters, scaling and parallax.
en-US.template.hint: Move the mouse or click to create glowing streams
